sandbox.heading: CAIL Sandbox
sandbox.description_html:
The CAIL Sandbox gives approved CUNY faculty, staff, and students an AI chat interface with open-weight models. Model-provider routes are configured not to retain prompts or outputs. That setting does not cover the surrounding app: the Sandbox normally saves conversations to your account. Do not submit sensitive or regulated data without institutional approval.

CAIL covers model usage; users are not billed. Each account has an assigned usage limit, and the displayed amount is a delayed estimate. Existing approved users sign in with CUNY Login. If you need access or cannot sign in, request access or support.

Check the Sandbox model selector for current availability. The Model Registry provides Lab-reviewed context for a smaller set of models.
